0022600159.text: The 5-1 Detroit Pistons, first in the Central and second in the East and riding a two-game winning streak, visit the 3-4 Charlotte Hornets, who are eighth in the East, 0.5 games back in the Southeast, and on a three-game losing streak. Detroit will be without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), while Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee, surgery). The Pistons lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 97-89 win in Detroit on October 28, and they won the 2025-26 series 3-0.
